sources.citation: Bhattacharya, Krishna (PI); Mitra, Poushali; Banerjee, Sayantani. [2022; accessioned 2022-01-20]. A Brief Grammatical Sketch of the Birjia Language (repository title: 'Analytical note on the compiled grammatical system of the Birjia language'). SPPEL-CIIL, Mysuru. 50 pp. hdl:20.500.14705/3400 (sanchika.ciil.org).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Phonology section covers vowels, consonants, clusters, syllable patterns; the SUPRASEGMENTALS paragraph (p.5) reads only: 'The phonemic status of length and nasalisation is not decided because of the limited data. Further investigation is necessary.' No mention of stress/accent anywhere in the 50 pp. (data from Gumla district, Jharkhand).

sources.harvard_location: Widener Library, call number 3254.1 F; Linguistics Library, call number CoPh 5.40; a Harvard library, call number Ud 0010
sources.note: No accent statement for Asuri/Brijia. Treats the Palamau Brijia word list 'as identical with Asuri'; Asuri 'Pronunciation.—The pronunciation mainly agrees with Mundari' (and under Mundari: 'The accent is the same as in Santali'), i.e. only an indirect chain, no statement about Brijia stress.
